newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica boosts Madrid stocks to new highs.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica boosts Madrid stocks to new highs.

text.p: Madrid stocks hit new highs at the close, fuelled by a rise in Telefonica and some large banks, but traders saw the market consolidating in the short term. * General index rose 1.66 points, 0.43 percent, to 383.41. * Ibex-35 index gained 21.86 points, 0.5 percent, to 4,406.65. * Telefonica was up 35 pesetas, 1.37 percent, to 2,590 with volume of 4.57 million shares, accounting for a quarter of total market volume. The share hit an annual high of 2,605 pesetas.
"Telefonica's strength, together with the rise in other shares, allows us to keep gaining but it's logical that there be a reversal at these price levels," said a trader at ABN-Amro.
